description: This file defines an abstract base controller class for administrative functions within the OrangeHRM plugin system. It provides permission checking and permission setting functionalities for derived admin controllers.

classes.name: BaseAdminController
classes.description: An abstract controller class providing permission management functionalities for admin controllers, including capability checks and permission setting into the Vue context.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns an array of data groups required for permission capability checking. Default implementation returns an empty array.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Checks whether the current user has the necessary permissions based on data groups to access the functionality.

methods.name: setPermissionsForController
methods.description: Sets the permission data into the Vue context for the specified data groups.
